descriptionText:
Item specifics
Brand: Port & Company

MPN: Does not apply
Custom Bundle: No
Modified Item: No
Condition
Pre-owned — good used condition. Shows minor signs of use and surface wear consistent with age. No rips or major stains.
Description
This is a rare Vintage Port & Company black nylon drawstring bag featuring InlineLeague.com and Rollerblade branded graphics — likely a promotional item from a past inline league or event. The tag inside reads BG85 and 100% nylon. These bags were never mass-sold as standalone retail products and are hard to find online.
Perfect for collectors of rollerblade memorabilia, inline hockey/roller sports gear, or anyone who loves unique vintage sport promo items.
